title: GitHub governance execution chain lost canonical authorization provenance and the publication gate validated an authorization label instead of canonical authority
symptoms: Canonical authorization artifacts for 207, 208, 209 and 210 are absent at the reconciled baseline.
Technical activity and successful runs exist for portions of 208-210 despite incomplete canonical authority provenance.
The legacy publication gate accepts the syntactic presence of an Authorization: AUTHORIZATION_... label but does not validate the referenced canonical authorization artifact or its scope/lifecycle.
The Canonical Authority Gate v2 now rejects a nonexistent authorization at validator level, but is not yet bound as a required canary status check.
Approval separation is not established and main remains without publication enforcement.
Authorization requests historically used copyable scripts inconsistently rather than through a mandatory protocol.
corrective_action: Authorization 211 established a mandatory textual approval-response protocol, schema and template.
Reconcile 204-210 without fabricating missing historical authorization artifacts.
Authorization 212 implements and validates fail-closed canonical authority resolution on the canary before any binding or later enforcement conclusion.
Bind the validated control to the canary ruleset and complete remaining bounded A1 tests before any A1 operational PASS.
